result.stdout:
freds-mcp v1.0.0 — MCP server for find/grep/sed/awk

Usage:
  freds-mcp install [claude|vscode|copilot|all]
      Update tool, configure MCP clients (Claude Code, VS Code, Copilot CLI).
  freds-mcp server
      Run the JSON-RPC server on stdin/stdout (MCP clients invoke this).
  freds-mcp help
      Print this help.

First-time setup:
  dotnet tool install -g FredsMCP
  freds-mcp install
